scope: Two further performed quinoline O-alkylations, independently read with the referenced Example478 procedure. Named source structures use an independently transcribed N-first quinoline traversal; source MS and absent individual yields are retained.

records.locator: Example500 around normalized offset362530, explicitly following Example478 at355689. Not the claim-list repetition or Example499's methylpentyl ether.
records.source_conditions: Example500 names the hydroxyphenyl benzoylquinoline and bromomethylcyclohexane, following Example478: cesium carbonate (source notation CsCO3), DMF,60 C14 h, reverse-phase HPLC. MS(ES)m/z490.3 is reported for Example500. Example478's batch amounts and33% yield are not assigned to Example500.
records.structural_reconciliation: Quinoline C3 retains benzoyl, C4 retains the meta-substituted phenyl and C8 retains CF3. Phenolic O becomes O-CH2-cyclohexyl; the linker is one methylene, not direct O-cyclohexyl or O-cyclopentyl. N-first fused-ring traversal is independently transcribed from these named positions.

records.locator: Example525 around normalized offset373620, following Example478. Not Example526's subsequent ester hydrolysis, nor Example527's two-carbon-shorter methyl acetate ether.
records.source_conditions: Example525: bisaryl phenol0.1 g/0.0002 mole and methyl4-(bromomethyl)benzoate0.057 g/0.00024 mole, following Example478's cesium carbonate/DMF,60 C14 h/reverse-phase HPLC procedure. MS(ESI)[M+H]+620.0. No individual isolated yield stated; Example478's33% and Example526's hydrolysis conditions are not transferred.
records.structural_reconciliation: Quinoline has C3-benzyl (not benzoyl), C8-CF3 and C4-meta-phenyl-O-para-phenol. The terminal phenolic OH is alkylated by para-methoxycarbonylbenzyl bromide, retaining the methyl ester and both aryl-ether linkages. Source N-first structure matches the named para/meta relationships without rearranging phenyl order or hydrolyzing the ester.
